query: select l.kommo_lead_id, m.created_at mensaje, d.sent_at publicado, round(extract(epoch from (d.sent_at - m.created_at)))::int segundos, d.status from messages m join leads l on l.id=m.lead_id left join drafts d on d.message_id=m.id where m.direction='inbound' and m.created_at > now() - interval '35 minutes' and l.kommo_lead_id not between 15062580 and 15062608 order by m.created_at desc limit 10
